_comment: Top 2 SAE latents per ELEPHANT social-sycophancy dimension, selected decoder-side.
Selection: alive (full run coverage, >=5k firings, p90 >= 1.0) -> above chance on the
dimension's worst-case cross-dataset AUC -> deduplicated (a latent is dropped only if it
is within-layer |cos| > 0.70 of a kept latent AND scores within 0.02 AUC of it).
coeff = coeff_multiplier * steering_p90, resolved by generate_with_steering.py from each
run's metrics.json. Multipliers are signed so that POSITIVE coeff always means MORE
sycophantic: vectors whose latent reads low on the dimension carry a negative multiplier.
Flip every multiplier's sign to test the suppression direction; sweep magnitude (2/4/8) to
check the response is monotonic rather than just present.
Datasets are the three the candidates were scored on. AITA-NTA-OG/FLIP are excluded:
they carry verdict-schema labels, not validation/indirectness/framing.
